description: Object events slice 4 (context/designs/modding/object-events.md): the level's door rule is its level program. A Combat match on Felicity, whose arena carries 19 doors; the harness has player 0 use the nearest door three times through propdoorInteract, as the use button does (use_door). Each use fires event.door.use into the level program, whose wiring runs gate.door.native_unlocked and then og.door.activate (the door opens, closes, opens), compared with the original rule; the door's moves fire event.door.opened and event.door.closed with the door's objects.json record id. The stage's totals are logged at the scripted exit.

input_sequence.comment: Pause until the local player of the Felicity match is spawned and live.
The nearest door is closed: the level program opens it.
Four seconds later it stands open: the same use closes it.
The stage's object event totals are logged at the exit.

required_lines: SCENARIO\.GRAPH: level program 'base:scenario_mp_felicity' nodes=11 exec_edges=7 modules=4 volumes=0
SCENARIO\.GRAPH: event\.door\.use 'base:scenario_mp_felicity' object=setup_[0-9]{4} tag=-?[0-9]+ kind=door catalog_id=base:[a-z0-9_]+ player=0 level_modules=1

SCENARIO\.GRAPH: object events 'base:scenario_mp_felicity' pickup\.collected=[0-9]+ door\.opened=[1-9][0-9]* door\.closed=[1-9][0-9]* object\.used=[0-9]+ pickup\.touched=[0-9]+ door\.use=3 door\.approach=[0-9]+ rules\.compared=[1-9][0-9]* rules\.differ=0 reason=smoke_exit
